baslik: The Day Humans First Flew 🎈 November 21, 1783 #onthisday
aciklama:
On November 21, 1783, Pilâtre de Rozier and the Marquis d'Arlandes made the first free human flight in a hot air balloon over Paris. King Louis XVI had wanted two condemned prisoners to go first...

One minute of history, every day.

Sources: Wikipedia (Pilâtre de Rozier, Montgolfier brothers).
Images: Wikimedia Commons, public domain and CC0 (Bibliothèque nationale de France, US Library of Congress, Paris Musées, Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum).
Music: "Baroque Heaven" by younoise (Freesound, CC0).
Voice-over and editing made with the help of AI.
